cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say I earned the quiz trophy. I taught you to revise a little every night; don't call it luck when I use the same method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spotted the subject, at least. I spent six months learning birds while you were skipping the revision cards. Call that preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But I still had to answer them. Put 'earned it' in your congratulations; you know how much work those cards take because I used to test you on them.
